name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Nash's grade is lower than both the class in the Studio and the member of the Robotics club.
The class in the Workshop's grade is at least 5% more than Nash.
The member of the Chess club's grade is immediately below the class with Piper.
Carver has a higher grade than the class with Piper.
The member of the Robotics club's grade is higher than both the class in the Studio and the class with Noah.
